prompt: Create a desktop landing page UI comp for BongkarLabel, an Indonesian food-label reader, edge to edge at 1440 by 1000, crisp readable Indonesian text, no browser or device frame. Visitors want to photograph a food label and understand ingredients before buying. Use real content: 'Foto labelnya. Kenali isinya.', 'Foto komposisi dan tabel gizinya. Periksa hasil baca, lalu lihat ringkasan sesuai kebutuhan Anda.', primary action 'Mulai scan label', secondary 'Cara kerjanya', 'Tanpa membuat akun'. Navigation contains BongkarLabel, Cara membaca label, Masuk. No testimonials, invented metrics or accuracy claims. This new identity is Indeks Belanja: mulberry #491d36 owns a major page region, pale rose #f5edf2 holds reading surfaces, citron #eff28f marks the main action. Use a sturdy open humanist sans with purposeful large headings, compact legible body copy and rounded rectangular controls. No blue, gradients, decorative badges or eyebrow text. A compact aligned ingredient readout is its signature. Composition three is journey-led: a sweeping mulberry page field carries the headline at the top, then an asymmetric continuous horizontal three-step reading path: 'Foto label', 'Periksa hasil baca', 'Lihat ringkasan'. Integrate the large citron 'Mulai scan label' control into the first step, with compact text explaining camera access is requested when activated. Let the last step show a small flat ingredient readout, no fake result or invented nutrition values. The next pale-rose section begins with 'Bahan yang asing, jadi lebih jelas.' Navigation remains conventional and readable. This should be bolder in composition than a standard split hero while retaining a single dominant narrative and enough calm space to read.
